name: Red Cloud Shuttle (Xích Hà Toa)
lore: A long needle-shuttle of red sandalwood tipped with bronze, which Thân Vân Cẩm has woven every bolt of the pavilion's fire-silk with since 1150. She named it for the Xích Hà Kỳ, the banner she means one day to equal.
build_use: The head's weaving weapon: burning threads and longer Fire stacks.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Robe of the First Weave (Sơ Chức Bào)
lore: The first fire-silk robe woven without the vents, in 1150, from Tang Điền's worms and Thân Vân Cẩm's own Fire. Tang Mộng Kiển has rewoven it two hundred times since, a thread at a time, so that it has never quite been ash.
build_use: The worm-keeper's robe: Fire resistance and a mending body.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Season-Woven Robe (Quý Chức Bào)
lore: Her own robe of vent-less fire-silk, rewoven every season when the last one chars. This is the two hundredth.
build_use: Binding threads, and a robe that does not burn in its own fire.
